<!-- Source page: Blackfire profiler -->

[Blackfire profiler](https://docs.blackfire.io/) is a proprietary tool for profiling applications. There are several languages supported by the product but currently only PHP support is packaged in Nixpkgs.

It is documented in the [NixOS manual](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#module-services-blackfire).
